concept.concept: A vintage botanical illustration of various wild mushrooms arranged in a circular wreath with the text 'Seek & Spore' in earthy serif lettering.
concept.audience: Foragers, cottagecore enthusiasts, nature hobbyists aged 25-45
concept.rationale: Foraging content explodes every September-October; mushroom aesthetics have sustained momentum on social platforms. Low IP risk, passionate community, 6-8 weeks puts us right in peak fall buying window.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Seek & Spore" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a circular wreath made of various wild mushrooms in silhouette and bold simple shapes. Include 8-10 different mushroom varieties: toadstools with spotted caps, delicate chanterelles, shelf fungi, puffballs, and morels arranged in a complete ring composition. Center is empty white space. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. High contrast screen-print aesthetic with clean sharp edges. Limited palette: deep forest green, warm terracotta, cream, dark charcoal brown, and pale sage. Single centered composition on a solid warm cream background with generous margin all around. Readable and impactful at 12x16 inches.
design.style: Bold earthy serif lettering arched along the top inner curve of the wreath, integrated into the circular composition without floating outside the design boundaries.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Seek & Spore' appears to be an original wordplay construction with no known trademark conflicts. The vintage botanical mushroom wreath illustration concept is a generic artistic style with no protected IP associations. The earthy serif lettering is a common design choice. No celebrity, brand, character, lyric, or slogan references are present. The overall concept is original and commercially safe for print-on-demand.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'SEEK & SPORE' correctly spelled and complete. The artwork features a clean circular arrangement of illustrated mushrooms in earthy tones with bold dark green typography on a plain cream background. No IP concerns, no quality issues, no anatomical problems, and the text is fully legible and accurate.
